title: PersuasiveToM: A Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Theory of Mind in Persuasive Dialogues
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for Theory of Mind (ToM) in persuasive dialogues. While 'Ethics' is mentioned as one of 35 diverse domains used to source the dialogue content, the benchmark itself focuses on cognitive state tracking (desires, beliefs, and intentions) rather than evaluating religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
